<thought>To find the required template, I will search the template catalog for a forward reaction that breaks an ester and forms an aliphatic hydroxyl, which matches the DIBAL‑H reduction described. This should return the template ID and its SMARTS, from which I can obtain the mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ester"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyl"],
    "bonds_order_changed": ["C-O (2.0->1.0)"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
